
#  不同类型样品之间的差异

## 加载需要的包

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(patchwork)
library(purrr)
library(multcompView)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

### 加载数据集

```{r}
physeq <- readRDS("./data/dada2/microplate/filtered/physeq.rds") 
physeq_filtered <- readRDS("./data/dada2/soil/filtered/physeq.rds") 
```

### α多样性分析

```{r}
alpha_physeq <- estimate_richness(physeq, measures = c("Shannon", "Simpson", "Chao1")) %>%
  mutate(Dataset = "physeq", storage = "All", type = "All")

alpha_filtered <- estimate_richness(physeq_filtered, measures = c("Shannon", "Simpson", "Chao1")) %>%
  mutate(Dataset = "physeq_filtered")

meta_filtered <- as.data.frame(sample_data(physeq_filtered))[, c("storage", "type")]
alpha_filtered <- cbind(alpha_filtered, meta_filtered[rownames(alpha_filtered), ])

alpha_all <- bind_rows(alpha_physeq, alpha_filtered) %>%
  mutate(Group = ifelse(Dataset == "physeq", "physeq", paste0(storage, "_", type)))
```

### 不同处理的Shannno多样性差异

```{r}
fresh_df <- alpha_all %>%
  filter(storage %in% c("fresh", "All")) %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("soil", "cell", "All")))

kw <- kruskal.test(Shannon ~ type, data = fresh_df)

pw <- pairwise.wilcox.test(fresh_df$Shannon, fresh_df$type, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
p_mat <- pw$p.value
p_adj <- p_mat[!is.na(p_mat)]
names(p_adj) <- paste(rownames(p_mat)[row(p_mat)[!is.na(p_mat)]], 
                      colnames(p_mat)[col(p_mat)[!is.na(p_mat)]], sep = "-")

letters <- multcompLetters(p_adj, threshold = 0.05)$Letters

rng <- diff(range(fresh_df$Shannon))
pos_df <- fresh_df %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  summarise(y_base = max(Shannon), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    letter = letters[as.character(type)],
    y_pos  = y_base + 0.1 * rng
  )

p2 <- ggplot(fresh_df, aes(x = type, y = Shannon, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    name   = "",
    breaks = c("soil", "cell", "All"),
    labels = c("soil", "cell", "flowcyto")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Group",
    breaks = c("fresh_soil", "fresh_cell", "physeq"),
    values = c(fresh_soil = "#009E73", fresh_cell = "#D55E00", physeq = "#0072B2"),
    labels = c(fresh_soil = "soil", fresh_cell = "cell", physeq = "flowcyto")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Alpha diversity (Shannon)", y = "Shannon diversity") +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.8) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 2, y = max(fresh_df$Shannon) + 0.2 * rng,
    label = paste0("p = ", signif(kw$p.value, 2)), fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = pos_df, aes(x = type, y = y_pos, label = letter),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, vjust = 0
  )

print(p2)
```

### 群落结构

```{r}
top10_genus_colors <- readRDS(
  "./data/dada2/microplate/top10_genus_colors.rds"
)

get_genus_data <- function(ps, group = NULL) {
  ps <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps) > 0, ps)
  ps <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x))
  df <- psmelt(ps)
  df %>%
    transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample),Group = if (is.null(group)) as.character(type) else group,
      Genus = if_else(
        is.na(Genus) | Genus == "","Unclassified",as.character(Genus)
      ),
      Relative_Abundance = Abundance
    )
}

genus_long <- bind_rows(
  get_genus_data(
    subset_samples(
      physeq_filtered,
      storage == "fresh" & type %in% c("soil", "cell")
    )
  ),
  get_genus_data(physeq, group = "flowcyto")
) %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group,levels = c("soil", "cell", "flowcyto")
    )
  )

genus_group <- genus_long %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  mutate(n_samples = n_distinct(Sample)) %>%
  group_by(Group, Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    Relative_Abundance =
      sum(Relative_Abundance, na.rm = TRUE) /
      dplyr::first(n_samples),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

top10_genus <- genus_group %>%
  filter(Genus != "Unclassified") %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(total_abundance = sum(Relative_Abundance),.groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  slice_max(total_abundance,n = 7,with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  pull(Genus)
plot_df <- genus_group %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = if_else(Genus %in% top10_genus, Genus, "Other")
  ) %>%
  group_by(Group, Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    Relative_Abundance = sum(Relative_Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = factor(Genus, levels = c(top10_genus, "Other"))
  )

missing_genus <- setdiff(
  top10_genus,
  names(top10_genus_colors)
)

plot_colors <- top10_genus_colors

if (length(missing_genus) > 0) {
  plot_colors <- c(
    plot_colors,
    setNames(
      scales::hue_pal()(length(missing_genus)),
      missing_genus
    )
  )
}

if (!"Other" %in% names(plot_colors)) {
  plot_colors <- c(plot_colors, Other = "#BDBDBD")
}

plot_colors <- plot_colors[c(top10_genus, "Other")]

p_composition <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = Group,
    y = Relative_Abundance,
    fill = Genus
  )
) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    position = position_fill(reverse = FALSE)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = plot_colors,
    name = "Genus",
    guide = guide_legend(reverse = FALSE)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL,y = "Relative Abundance" ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    aspect.ratio = 1.2
  )

p_composition
```
